purpose: Hand-curated calibration set for the per-code classification-difficulty pipeline. Each row is a real declarable commodity with manually-written ordinary-trader-style queries and the bucket we expect the classifier to predict. Used to spot-check that LLM-paraphrase + retrieval + action-bucket classifier agree with human intuition.

schema.expected_bucket: A (AI can classify) or B (needs operator intervention)
schema.expected_intercept_type: If bucket B, the recommended action type (description.exclude, description.filter, description.guidance, commodity.exclude, commodity.message, or lane:annotate_ai166_fix)
schema.queries: Hand-written trader-style search phrases. 2-8 words. No tariff jargon.
